readings.commitment: Canada wrote Westminster down: a constitution 'similar in principle to that of the United Kingdom' codified into a federal act, conventions imported wholesale alongside the text
readings.delta: Suppression of both pure-unwritten and pure-codified models; beneficiary is hybrid constitutionalism; victim set is single-model purists; extractiveness of imperial control retained at the founding (disallowance, appeals)

readings.commitment: Australia fused Westminster with Washington: responsible government inside a US-style federal structure with a powerful elected Senate — the 'Washminster' hybrid by design
readings.delta: Suppression of each model's pure logic by the other's presence; beneficiary is federal balance and the states; victim set is clean confidence-chamber doctrine (1975 proved it); extractiveness of supply blockable by the second chamber

readings.commitment: The Irish Free State took the form to leave the empire: a dominion constitution under the Treaty, then amended its own crown out clause by clause until 1937 replaced it
readings.delta: Suppression of republican form at the Treaty's insistence, then of the Treaty's terms by serial amendment; beneficiary shifted from imperial settlement to sovereign exit; victim set likewise; extractiveness of the oath and appeal removed by the instrument meant to entrench them

readings.commitment: The export's last wave was decolonization by template: Lancaster House texts with Westminster chambers and bills of rights, drafted in London for states that often rewrote or discarded them within a decade
readings.delta: Suppression of indigenous institutional design at independence; beneficiary is orderly transfer and the departing power's legal legacy; victim set is constitutional forms without local roots; extractiveness of the template's failures borne by the new states

readings.commitment: The 1867 Act centralized on purpose: POGG, disallowance, and the residue to Ottawa — a federation designed against the American secession it had just watched
readings.delta: Suppression of state-sovereignty federalism; beneficiary is the central government's designed primacy; victim set is provincial-autonomy claims (until the Privy Council reversed the tilt); extractiveness of provincial power recallable at the design stage

readings.commitment: Patriation finished the founding: the constitution brought home with an amending formula and the Charter, over Quebec's dissent — completion and wound in the same act
readings.delta: Suppression of the Westminster amendment channel; beneficiary is domestic constitutional autonomy and Charter claimants; victim set is Quebec's consent claim; extractiveness of the settlement carrying an unsigned province

readings.commitment: Section 33 is the export's signature compromise: legislatures may override Charter rights for five renewable years — parliamentary sovereignty preserved inside a rights constitution
readings.delta: Suppression of judicial finality by legislative declaration; beneficiary is the overriding legislature; victim set is overridden rights-holders for the clause's term; extractiveness of rights suspended at political cost

readings.commitment: Australia's design is deliberate fusion: cabinet government answering to the lower house, inside an American federal frame with equal-state Senate and judicial review
readings.delta: Suppression of each parent model's vetoes on the other; beneficiary is federation bargain-keeping; victim set is doctrinal purity; extractiveness negotiated between two logics permanently

readings.commitment: 1975 detonated the hybrid's fault line: a Senate blocking supply, a Governor-General dismissing an elected government — the reserve powers and the hybrid's contradiction live on television
readings.delta: Suppression of the confidence convention by the federal chamber; beneficiary is the blocking opposition and vice-regal discretion; victim set is the dismissed government and convention certainty; extractiveness of office through constitutional crisis

readings.commitment: Section 128 made the text nearly unamendable in practice: double-majority referendums that have passed eight of forty-five attempts — the people as a veto that almost always says no
readings.delta: Suppression of elite-driven textual change; beneficiary is the constitutional status quo; victim set is reform programs (including recognition); extractiveness of amendment priced at a double majority rarely paid

readings.commitment: Independence came pre-drafted: Westminster chambers, entrenched rights chapters, and minority protections negotiated in London conference rooms as the price of the date
readings.delta: Suppression of constituent-assembly authorship; beneficiary is negotiated transition and protected minorities on paper; victim set is founding-moment ownership; extractiveness of the terms set where the power still sat

readings.commitment: The templates died young: one-party states, presidents-for-life, and military councils replaced the exported forms across a decade — the transplant rejected by the body politic
readings.delta: Suppression of the imported checks by the first generation of inheritors; beneficiary is consolidating executives; victim set is oppositions the template was meant to protect; extractiveness recentralized after the flags changed

readings.commitment: Where it rooted, it transformed: India, and the Caribbean kept Westminster forms by rebuilding them on local material — survival through adaptation, not fidelity
readings.delta: Suppression of the fidelity-or-failure binary; beneficiary is adaptive constitutionalism; victim set is transplant determinism both ways; extractiveness of the form repaid where it was locally re-founded
